title: Foundry Platform Manifest
description: Declarative manifest for a Foundry-managed platform.

$schema.description: URI for the JSON Schema used to validate this manifest.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Foundry manifest specification.

repository.description: Name of the root repository folder for this platform (used by Foundry CLI).

servicesDir.description: Relative path to the directory containing runnable services (default: 'apps').

services.description: Launch configurations for discovered services. Keys are service names (directory names).

ci.description: Continuous Integration and infrastructure orchestration configuration.

provider.description: Primary infrastructure provider for this platform.

serviceConfig.description: Launch configuration for a single service.

enabled.description: Whether this service should be started by `foundry run`. Defaults to true.

port.description: The primary port the service listens on.

actuatorPort.description: The port for health/actuator endpoints (Spring Boot). Defaults to port if not set.

args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to the service start command.

env.description: Environment variables to set when running the service.
